$description: Semantic tokens that do not vary by theme — typography, shape and motion. Split out so the theme files contain only what actually differs, and a reviewer comparing light against dark is looking at a diff of colour rather than a diff of everything.

font-numeric.$description: Tabular figures are mandatory for values, doses and identifiers. A proportional 1 in a column of results breaks the alignment that makes the column scannable.

duration-fast.$description: Decorative motion is prohibited on clinical surfaces. These durations exist for state changes a user initiated, not for drawing attention.
